title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12732)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_12732) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12732). This Indian Standard (First Revision) was adopted by the by the Hand Pump Sectional Committee had been approved by the Mechanical Engineering Divisional Council. This standard was first published in 1989. In order to incorporate the changes in the packaging industry and to provide easy identification of various components of the deepwell handpump a need was felt to revise this Standard. This first revision of this standard incorporates Amendment No. 1 (July 1995). At its base level, product packaging serves to protect the product inside. Packaging is needed to protect the contents from damage, dust, dirt, leakage, pilferage, watering, and contamination. Packaging must also keep the product safe during shipment between the manufacturing facility and the retailer and must prevent damage while the product sits on the shelf. The outcome of such efforts is a more dependable and maintainable product. This standard has been brought out on the basis of information available from the industry a

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
